paragraphs.text:
HAWKSBILL TURTLE / 玳瑁
The hawksbill turtle is a protected marine animal. A product description or visual resemblance cannot by itself establish what a product is made from. When an unfamiliar animal-derived material appears in a product description, pause and check official sources. If a concern is discovered after purchase, stop using the item, preserve accurate records, and seek instructions through verified reporting channels.

This script keeps a fictional 2025 setting; the friend, dialogue, order notifications, investigation montage, and handcuff staging are dramatized, not verified details of the real incident.
